title: Off-orbit molecular task with private sparse residual
hypothesis: A low-dimensional target-molecule code over one shared correction basis is insufficient on off-orbit molecular conformations, but a small learned sparse private residual can restore both energy and force quality at less inference-state cost than a matched PA300 sparse fine-tune.
physical_object: Official frozen MACE-MP small crystal-trained interatomic potential
mirror_coordinate: Rank-2 molecule code m over a shared parameter-delta basis learned on benzene/toluene/naphthalene
logical_multiplicity: Molecule-specific potential corrections; uracil is a held-out target task

data.composition_boundary: C/H/N/O known elements; molecular-domain configuration OOD versus MACE-MP crystal prior, not unseen-element transfer
data.mirror: StructureCloud/rMD17 preprocessed per-molecule tensor files; original dataset CC0-1.0 per ColabFit card.
data.local_copy_note: Uracil file is downloaded in the container, but no uracil energies/forces/positions have been parsed or scored. Split membership is fixed by old_indices windows above.

split.ordering: published old_indices ascending; fixed original-index windows, not random frames
split.source_basis: for benzene/toluene/naphthalene select up to 128 records each with 0 <= old_indices < 100000 using SHA256(MA1004|source|molecule|old_index) order
split.target_support: uracil records with 0 <= old_indices < 100000; select 8/16/32 support rows with the same deterministic hash ordering
split.development: uracil 100000 <= old_indices < 200000; select up to 128 deterministic rows for rank/shot/private-state selection
split.fresh: uracil 500000 <= old_indices < 650000; select up to 64 deterministic rows after protocol and model/config/payload lock
split.deduplicate: SHA256 of atomic numbers and positions rounded to 1e-6 Angstrom; remove overlap from the later partition before reading any target labels

controls: frozen MACE-MP plus support-fitted task energy offset
shared rank-2 Mirror basis and molecule code
Mirror plus private sparse equivariant residual with mask/index bytes charged
full fine-tune upper control where feasible

development.selection_metric: Mean per-atom energy MAE and force-component MAE on uracil 20th-30th old-index percentile; source tasks fit basis only.
development.optimizer_updates: Record actual updates; fixed sample budgets and early-stop only on development data.

success_gate: Mirror+private sparse residual is within 5% of PA300 sparse control on both energy and force MAE, saves at least 25% actual total adaptation payload bytes, and adds at most 20% inference time; a Mirror-specific claim also requires beating the exact native factorization control.
failure_gate: Mirror-only/private residual miss energy or force quality; private state erases byte savings; PA300/native control matches or dominates at lower bytes/compute; or compute exceeds the frozen runtime gate.
boundaries: rMD17 molecule subset only; not bulk-material or catalyst evidence.
All tested elements are supported by the MACE-MP embedding; this is not unseen-element transfer.
No reaction barrier labels; no barrier claim.
No random-frame split; old_indices interval split and exact-geometry deduplication are required.
